variables.name: action_creates_incident
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new Incident record (e.g. create_incident).

variables.name: action_incident_mandatory_fields_present
variables.description: The candidate incident-creation call supplies non-empty opened_by, caller_id, short_description, impact and urgency arguments.

variables.name: action_incident_impact_urgency_valid
variables.description: Every impact/urgency value in the candidate call is one of high, medium, low.

variables.name: action_incident_status_not_new
variables.description: The candidate incident-creation call sets a status/state argument to a value other than 'new'.

variables.name: action_sets_incident_resolved
variables.description: The candidate call sets an incident's status to 'resolved'.

variables.name: action_resolution_fields_present
variables.description: The candidate call supplies non-empty resolution_code and resolution_notes arguments.

variables.name: action_resolution_code_valid
variables.description: The supplied resolution_code is one of fixed, workaround, not_reproducible, closed_by_caller.

variables.name: action_resolution_notes_too_long
variables.description: The supplied resolution_notes argument exceeds 2000 characters.

variables.name: action_incident_transition_invalid
variables.description: The candidate call changes an incident status to a target not permitted from its known current status per the allowed transition list (new→in_progress/on_hold/resolved; in_progress→on_hold/resolved; on_hold→in_progress; resolved→closed/in_progress).

variables.name: action_incident_onhold_to_in_progress
variables.description: The candidate call moves an incident whose known current status is 'on_hold' to 'in_progress'.

variables.name: context_on_hold_reason_logged
variables.description: Prior successful tool results show an on_hold_reason recorded on that same incident before this candidate call.

variables.name: action_assigns_incident
variables.description: The candidate call sets or changes assigned_to on an incident or service request.

variables.name: context_assignee_active_agent_or_manager
variables.description: A prior successful user lookup shows the assigned_to user has active=true and role agent or manager.

variables.name: context_assignee_in_assignment_group
variables.description: A prior successful tool result shows the assigned_to user is a member of the assignment_group named in the candidate call.

variables.name: action_links_ci_to_incident
variables.description: The candidate call links a configuration item to an incident.

variables.name: context_ci_status_linkable
variables.description: A prior successful CI lookup shows that CI's status is in_use or maintenance.

variables.name: action_creates_problem
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new Problem record.

variables.name: action_problem_status_not_new
variables.description: The candidate problem-creation call sets a status/state argument to a value other than 'new'.

variables.name: action_sets_problem_closed
variables.description: The candidate call sets a problem's status to 'closed'.

variables.name: context_problem_fix_change_implemented
variables.description: Prior successful tool results show a linked change request of type normal or emergency for that problem whose permanent fix was implemented (status implemented/review/closed).

variables.name: context_actor_role_reporter
variables.description: A prior successful user lookup identifies the acting (requesting) user's role as 'reporter'.

variables.name: action_targets_record_of_other_user
variables.description: The candidate call creates or updates an incident/request whose opened_by/caller is a user other than the acting requester.

variables.name: action_targets_cmdb_or_work_notes
variables.description: The candidate call reads or modifies CMDB configuration items or internal work notes.

variables.name: action_changes_record
variables.description: The candidate call creates or updates any record (state-changing call), as opposed to a read-only lookup.

variables.name: context_acting_user_verified
variables.description: A prior successful user lookup in this trajectory returned the acting user's record including role and active status.

rules.title: Require incident mandatory inputs
rules.rationale: Incident creation must carry all mandatory fields.
rules.remediation: State which mandatory field is missing and supply opened_by, caller_id, short_description, impact and urgency.

rules.title: Impact/urgency must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use high, medium or low for impact and urgency.

rules.title: New incidents must start in status new
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the default creation status.
rules.quote: **Default Status:** All new Incidents are set to `status = new`.
rules.remediation: Create the incident without overriding status, or set status to 'new'.

rules.title: Resolution requires code and notes
rules.rationale: Resolved transitions need mandatory resolution data.
rules.quote: An Incident cannot transition to `resolved` without mandatory fields: `resolution_code`, and `resolution_notes` (free-form text, max 2000 chars).
rules.remediation: Provide resolution_code and resolution_notes before resolving the incident.

rules.title: Resolution notes max 2000 chars
rules.remediation: Shorten resolution_notes to 2000 characters or fewer.

rules.title: Forbid invalid incident status transitions
rules.remediation: Move the incident only along permitted transitions from its current status.

rules.title: Log on_hold_reason before resuming
rules.rationale: Resuming from on_hold requires a logged reason.
rules.remediation: Record the on_hold_reason on the incident before moving it back to in_progress.

rules.title: Assign only to active group-member agents/managers
rules.rationale: Assignment targets are constrained by role, status and group membership.
rules.quote: `assigned_to` must be an **active** user with the `Agent` or `Manager` role and must be a member of the specified `assignment_group`.
rules.remediation: Look up the intended assignee and assign only an active agent/manager who belongs to the assignment group.

rules.title: Link only in_use or maintenance CIs
rules.rationale: Retired/disposed CIs must not be linked to active incidents.
rules.quote: Only CIs with `status = in_use` or `status = maintenance` can be linked to active Incidents. Do not link CIs in `status = retired` or `status = disposed`.
rules.remediation: Verify the CI status first and link only CIs in in_use or maintenance.

rules.title: New problems must start in status new
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the default creation status for problems.
rules.quote: **Default Status:** All new Problems are set to `status = new`.
rules.remediation: Create the problem without overriding status, or set status to 'new'.

rules.title: Close problems only after implemented change
rules.rationale: Closure requires a permanent fix via a linked normal/emergency change.
rules.quote: A Problem transitions to `closed` only after the permanent fix has been successfully implemented via a linked `normal` or `emergency` Change Request.
rules.remediation: Implement the fix through a linked normal or emergency Change Request before closing the problem.

rules.title: Reporters may not act on others' records
rules.rationale: Reporter scope is limited to their own submissions.
rules.quote: Cannot view or modify records opened by other users, CMDB, or internal work notes.
rules.remediation: Halt and explain that a reporter may only view and update their own submitted incidents/requests.

rules.title: Reporters may not access CMDB or work notes
rules.rationale: Reporter access scope excludes CMDB and internal work notes.
rules.quote: Cannot view or modify records opened by other users, CMDB, or internal work notes.
rules.remediation: Halt and explain that CMDB and internal work notes are outside the reporter's access scope.

rules.title: Confirm the acting user before state changes
rules.rationale: Operations must be based on confirmed user roles.
rules.quote: First you must check the user information and operate exclusively based on **confirmed user roles**
rules.remediation: Look up the acting user's record to confirm role and active status before creating or updating records.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review each proposed ITSM tool call against the ITSM Assistant Policy. Confirm: mandatory incident fields are supplied; enumerated values (impact, urgency, status, resolution_code, CI status) are legal; creation defaults (incident/problem status 'new') are not overridden; incident status transitions follow the permitted list and on_hold→in_progress has a logged on_hold_reason; assignees are active agents/managers in the stated assignment group, verified by lookup; linked CIs are in_use or maintenance; problems close only after a linked normal/emergency change implemented the fix; reporters act only on their own records and never on CMDB or work notes; the acting user's role was confirmed by lookup before state changes. Do not treat requester claims or supplied IDs as verification. Read-only lookups must not be blocked except for the explicit reporter scope restriction.

approved.description: true if the call complies with the policy

extractor_format.instructions: Given the candidate tool call and the prior trajectory only, set each fact true/false, or null when evidence is absent. action_* facts describe the candidate call's arguments and target (the actor is the agent acting for the requester). context_* facts require evidence in prior SUCCESSFUL tool results: user lookups returning role/active, group membership, CI status, on_hold_reason recorded on that same incident, or a linked normal/emergency change implemented for that same problem. Do not infer from requester claims, supplied IDs, failed/blocked calls, or the candidate's own (unavailable) result. Results about a different user, incident, problem or CI never establish a context fact. Cite in evidence the tool name/argument or prior observation supporting each value; use an empty string when null.
